verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a SaaS notarization and incorporation service, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question, but the evidence shows no in-product assistant users can delegate tasks to. The only AI mention is automatic detection of signature and date fields during notarization, which is an adjacent feature, not a delegable assistant. The llms.txt files serve external agents, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
